'''Epica City''' was a major [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Epica]]. It was the site of the [[Hydians Auction House|Hydians]] auction house and [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Lestra Oxic]]'s [[Lestra Oxic's mansion|mansion]].
